name: claude-skillet
description: Personal Claude Code skills, packaged one plugin per skill so each can be installed and toggled independently.

plugins.name: wp-ops
plugins.description: Safe WordPress operations via WP-CLI, local or over SSH: per-project install registry, pre-op DB snapshots, cache-layer purge ordering, dual-row ACF handling, and sanitized prod-to-local cloning.

plugins.name: wrap
plugins.description: End-of-session close-out: sweep memory, project docs, working tree, lingering processes, and loose ends, then confirm it's safe to close the terminal.
